Name: No Soil Decay On Farm
Author: sodenke
Description:
[b]Config[/b]
"﻿farmonly": true
﻿ ﻿- Will only stop soil reverting on the main farm
﻿﻿"farmonly": false
﻿ ﻿- Will stop soil reverting outside the main farm as well
"﻿reapplyfertilzer": true
﻿ ﻿- Will reapply fertilizer after re-tilling the locations
﻿﻿"reapplyfertilzer": false
﻿ ﻿- Will not reapply fertilizer after re-tilling the locations

[size=4][b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b][/size] The reapplyfertilzer option is not compatible with Ultimate Fertilizer mod and likely not other fertilizer mods as well. So set it to false if you use any.

Downloads.Description: Fixed folder structure. Should be able to install normally now.

Manifest.Name: NoSoilDecayOnFarm
Manifest.Description: Prevents 'hoe dirt' from reverting to normal ground on the farm
Manifest.Author: A_Dude
